name: a dashboard wall of real output backs the headline
looks: A browser window holds a dense dashboard grid of small generated-site previews, filling nearly the whole frame. A two-line headline fades in over it, naming how many people are exploring a new way to build, its last few words landing a beat after the rest.
build: The dashboard grid is a single DOM panel with many small image tiles in a fixed layout; the headline is a separate fixed layer above it with a soft shadow for legibility, its final clause fading/rising in slightly after the first line.
sound: A low ambient bed under the hold, a soft rise under the headline's final clause.
prompt: Hold a dense dashboard grid of small generated-output previews filling almost the whole frame, with a two-line headline fading in over it naming the scale of people using the product, its final clause landing a beat after the rest.
